AppKit backend for ui/nativemenu.nim. See nativemenu.m.

Menus are opaque pointers (NSMenu *) as far as the facade is concerned, and items are addressed by the integer tag the facade allocated for them - which is also what the single Objective-C target hands back when one is clicked.

AppKit matches a key equivalent itself, before the key press ever reaches the application's event loop, so there is nothing to match here - and matching it a second time would run the action twice.
